findings.summary: Lag and rolling features are not grouped by store_id (and rows may be unsorted or have missing dates), so values leak across stores and shift(7) may not mean same weekday last week; dropna only removes the first 7 rows of the whole frame.

test_calendar_features passes by coincidence because dropping the first 7 rows shifts out.loc[0] to 2026-01-08, which is also a Thursday; also test_lag_features uses a single store so it cannot catch the cross-store leakage.
